observations: Photo 0 shows two PlayStation 5 consoles: one original 'Fat' model and one 'Slim' model, both with disc drives.
Photo 0 shows three DualSense controllers (two white, one black).
Photo 1 shows a PS5 Slim console next to its retail box and two white DualSense controllers.
The retail box in photo 1 has 'SONY' and 'PS5' branding visible.
The background in photo 1 shows a shop environment with 'BUCHI TECH SPACE' signage.
Watermarks for 'BUCHI_TECH' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on the images.

claims.evidence: The console in photo 1 and the right-hand console in photo 0 show the distinct horizontal slit of the Slim model.
The left-hand console in photo 0 is the original larger PS5 model.
Photo 0 shows three controllers and photo 1 shows two, which contradicts the text claim of only one.
